F1_damping_sign.physical_consequence: Creation enhances damping, not weakens it. System is MORE stable with alpha>0, not less.

F2_D0_calibration.problem: Factor sqrt(2) ambiguity in D0 calibration, ~40% error in all length scales
F2_D0_calibration.root_cause: Cattaneo overdamped damping is 2*(1-q) vs original DGF's (1-q) — factor 2 from tau_c*d_t R(q) term
F2_D0_calibration.resolution: Keep gamma0 definition unchanged (from Lindblad level); explicitly write D0 = 2c^2/gamma0
F2_D0_calibration.systematic_uncertainty: Length scales in range [c/(gamma0*sqrt(alpha)), sqrt(2)*c/(gamma0*sqrt(alpha))]; use conservative upper bound D0=2c^2/gamma0 for comparisons with observation

F3_gaussian_applicability.problem: N1 Gaussian width derived assuming q << 1 (u -> -infinity); fails at alpha -> 1 where q* -> 1

applicability_regions.region_A_alpha_ll_1: Fully applicable — Gaussian |0> island in |1> sea, w = (c/gamma0)*sqrt(2/alpha)
applicability_regions.region_B_alpha_approx_0.5: Gaussian not appropriate; use domain wall solution xi = (c/gamma0)*sqrt(2/(alpha*(1-alpha)))
applicability_regions.region_C_alpha_to_1: Gaussian expansion FAILS; use dual expansion with q=1-delta_q, xi = c/(gamma0*sqrt(1-alpha))

n4_cosmological_tension.problem_statement: R2 Gamma_eff = gamma0 * exp(-z*chi_bar/q(1-q)) appears to vanish exponentially for cosmological N~10^80, predicting a completely frozen universe — contradicting observed cosmic activity

path_I_causal_horizon.core_argument: N_eff in Kramers formula is causal neighborhood size z=O(1), NOT global DOF count N~10^80
path_I_causal_horizon.key_insight: chi_bar(tilde) is an average over edges. In a causal graph, only edges within causal horizon (r_c = c/gamma0) have non-zero chi. chi_bar is therefore independent of system size N in thermodynamic limit: chi_bar -> chi_bar_local = O(1)
path_I_causal_horizon.derivation: Sum_{(i,j) in E} chi_ij ~ (zN/2)*chi_bar_local, |E|=zN/2, so chi_bar = chi_bar_local = O(1)
path_I_causal_horizon.effective_exponent: N_eff * chi_bar / q(1-q) = z * chi_bar_local / q(1-q) = O(1)
path_I_causal_horizon.gamma_eff_estimate: For z=6, chi_max=1, q=0.5: Gamma_eff ~ gamma0*exp(-24) ~ 3.8e-11*gamma0
path_I_causal_horizon.events_per_universe_age: ~3.0e50 events per site — universe far from frozen

path_II_scale_free.core_argument: Scale-free causal graph topology (P(k) ~ k^{-gamma}, 2<gamma<3) creates hub nodes with very small local chi_bar, maintaining non-zero Gamma_eff at hubs
path_II_scale_free.limitation: Requires DGF causal graph to be scale-free — not yet proven

path_III_non_poisson.core_argument: Heavy-tailed chi fluctuations (Levy distribution) replace exponential Kramers suppression with power-law suppression
path_III_non_poisson.limitation: No proof that DGF micro-jump dynamics produce non-Poissonian fluctuations

path_IV_coarse_graining.status: DEMOTED — conflicts with DGF Planck-scale positioning
path_IV_coarse_graining.core_argument: DGF lattice spacing >> Planck length reduces N, avoiding exponential suppression
path_IV_coarse_graining.limitation: Conflicts with DGF's 'Planck-scale causal atom' self-description

resolution_assessment.definitiveness: Path I is a clean causal locality argument requiring no new axioms or free parameters
resolution_assessment.remaining_caveat: For very dense causal graphs (z >> 1), local suppression e^{-O(z)} could still be significant. But observed cosmic activity is concentrated in sparse regions (galaxy centers, stars) where effective z is small.
resolution_assessment.inspector_evaluation: PASS — causal horizon cutoff resolves the tension at physicist-level rigor

P1_cmb_landing_A.prediction: CMB low-l power suppression with Gaussian cutoff form
P1_cmb_landing_A.l_DGF: ~O(10-40), depends on inflation model matching (eta factor)
P1_cmb_landing_A.physical_origin: During the Planck epoch, super-horizon modes (wavelength > causal horizon c/H) have chi=0 -> no braking -> pure DGF heat-death dynamics -> fluctuation power suppressed. Sub-horizon modes develop chi>0 -> braking active -> power unsuppressed.
P1_cmb_landing_A.connection_to_observation: Planck 2013/2018 reports 5-10% power deficit at l <~ 40, significance 2.5-3 sigma. DGF provides a physical mechanism for this deficit.
P1_cmb_landing_A.ref_support: Shankaranarayanan & Sriramkumar (2004, hep-th/0410072): Planck-scale effects naturally suppress large-scale CMB power

falsifiability.method: CMB-S4 TT+EE joint analysis at l=2-50
falsifiability.falsification_condition: If CMB-S4 measures low-l power consistent with LCDM at <1 sigma (no deficit), DGF prediction is falsified
falsifiability.discriminant: Gaussian cutoff form [1-exp(-l^2/l_DGF^2)] is distinguishable from: spatial topology (sharp cutoff), inflation dynamics modification (oscillatory/step), cosmic strings (power-law modification)

P2_quantum_simulator_landing_B.prediction: Exponential relationship between effective creation rate Gamma_eff and measured mean positive correlation chi_bar
test_procedure: 1. Prepare initial state on NxN DGF lattice in quantum simulator (Rydberg array, ion trap, superconducting qubits)
2. Evolve under DGF jump dynamics (L_ij + L2 creation operator) to steady state
3. Measure steady-state q and chi_bar via site-resolved readout
4. Inject local perturbation (flip one |1> -> |0>), measure recovery time tau_recovery
6. Repeat for different initial conditions, collect (chi_bar, Gamma_eff) data points
P2_quantum_simulator_landing_B.falsifiability: If data shows linear (not exponential) relationship, or exponential coefficient differs from z by >2sigma, prediction is falsified
P2_quantum_simulator_landing_B.experimental_readiness: Required capabilities (site-resolved readout, tunable jump operators) exist on current Rydberg atom array platforms (Harvard/Browaeys group). Testable in 1-3 years.

layer_1_causal_locality_formal.title: Causal horizon cutoff — formal theory of locality as organizing principle for non-equilibrium thermodynamics
layer_1_causal_locality_formal.core_result: Distinction between global collective escape (rate ~ exp(-N*Delta_s)) and local independent escape (rate ~ exp(-z*Delta_s_local)). DGF causal graph structure FORCES local escape because information speed is bounded by c.
layer_1_causal_locality_formal.causal_neighborhood: N_c(i) = {j: d_G(i,j) <= 1}, in continuum: B(i, r_c) with r_c = c*tau_c = c/gamma0 = l_P
layer_1_causal_locality_formal.scaling_in_thermodynamic_limit: z -> constant, chi_bar -> constant, Gamma_eff -> constant (all independent of N as N->infinity)
layer_1_causal_locality_formal.contrast_with_equilibrium: Unlike equilibrium critical phenomena where order parameter scales with system size, DGF's non-equilibrium dynamics avoid global cooperativity, hence avoiding exponential catastrophe

layer_2_holographic_isomorphism.title: Structural isomorphism between DGF causal locality and holographic principle
layer_2_holographic_isomorphism.observation: Both DGF causal locality and holographic principle replace volume-scaling (N ~ V/l_P^d) with area/boundary-scaling (N_eff ~ A/l_P^{d-1})
layer_2_holographic_isomorphism.dimensional_reduction: DGF causal dynamics exhibits d -> d-1 dimensional reduction in thermodynamic limit — effective DOFs live on causal horizon surfaces, not in bulk volume
layer_2_holographic_isomorphism.physical_correspondence: DGF causal horizon radius r_c = c*tau_c = l_P coincides with minimum black hole horizon radius (one Planck mass BH). DGF may be the 'causal skeleton' of quantum gravity.
testable_corollaries: Area law in quantum simulator: subsystem active causal DOFs proportional to |boundary(A)|, not |A|
Cosmological horizon scaling: active DOFs concentrate on dynamical horizons (Hubble, particle), not in bulk
CMB boundary effects: low-l cutoff form reflects horizon boundary conditions, not volumetric effects
layer_2_holographic_isomorphism.honesty_label: SPECULATIVE — formal analogy, not proven equivalence. AdS/CFT mathematical bridge to DGF missing.

layer_3_local_causal_second_law.title: Conjecture: local causal thermodynamic second law
layer_3_local_causal_second_law.definition: S_local(i) = -k_B * sum_{j in N_c(i)} [q_j*ln(q_j) + (1-q_j)*ln(1-q_j)] - k_B * sum_{(j,k) subset N_c(i)} I(j:k)
layer_3_local_causal_second_law.physical_meaning: Local entropy CAN decrease (via creation processes), but the decrease rate is bounded by chi braking strength. When chi_ij -> chi_max (Frechet bound), local entropy decrease rate -> 0 — system reaches local thermal equilibrium (while remaining globally non-equilibrium).
layer_3_local_causal_second_law.formal_analogy: Similar to black hole Generalized Second Law: dS_total = dS_BH + dS_matter >= 0, where local entropy decrease is compensated by 'causal horizon entropy' increase.
layer_3_local_causal_second_law.honesty_label: CONJECTURE — not proven. Requires closed-form chi matrix dynamics (B's open problem) and complete entropy production analysis.

IC4_adversarial_audit.attack_1: Causal horizon argument is redefinition trick — relabeling N_eff from global to local DOF and claiming catastrophe disappears
IC4_adversarial_audit.response_1: Not redefinition but precise definition. Kramers Delta_S is entropy cost of a LOCAL escape event. Correlations chi_ij are only defined on edges with causal connection. Pairs beyond causal horizon have chi=0 identically. Multiplying global N by local chi_bar is a category error — the two quantities live at different scales. Causal graph structure enforces N_eff * chi_bar = z * chi_bar_local = O(1).
IC4_adversarial_audit.attack_2: CMB low-l suppression prediction (P1) is not unique to DGF — multiple models predict it. No discriminative power.
IC4_adversarial_audit.response_2: Partially true but misses the point. DGF predicts: (1) Specific GAUSSIAN functional form [1-exp(-l^2/l_DGF^2)], distinguishable from sharp cutoff (topology), oscillatory (inflation modification), or power-law (cosmic strings). (2) IDENTICAL suppression form in TT and EE — a joint constraint most models don't require. (3) The existence of suppression is robust; if CMB-S4 finds no suppression, DGF is falsified regardless of model degeneracy.
IC4_adversarial_audit.severity_2: MEDIUM — requires CMB-S4 data for discrimination
IC4_adversarial_audit.attack_3: No numerical simulation or new experimental data. All 'corrections' are pen-and-paper derivations. R2's S3-B (MC validation) still outstanding.
IC4_adversarial_audit.response_3: Correct that A博士's framework is theoretical derivation. However, R3 provides P2 with explicit quantum simulator test protocol (steps, fitting method, falsifiability condition) — actionable without A personally running simulations. MC validation (S3-B) is B博士's path.
IC4_adversarial_audit.severity_3: LOW-MEDIUM — prediction is actionable; division of labor between A (theory) and B (simulation)
IC4_adversarial_audit.attack_4: Holographic isomorphism (§4.2) is physicist's analogy-mongering — finding formal similarity between unrelated fields and claiming deep connection without any quantitative testable distinction.
IC4_adversarial_audit.response_4: Valid criticism. Clarifications: (1) Section explicitly labeled SPECULATIVE. (2) Three testable corollaries proposed (§4.2.4) — area law in quantum simulator, horizon scaling in cosmology, boundary effects in CMB. (3) Holographic principle itself remains largely conjectural outside AdS. DGF may or may not be connected — this is an exploratory direction, not a claimed result.
IC4_adversarial_audit.severity_4: LOW — honestly labeled as speculation with testable corollaries
